title: Nitsum — Tiered-SLO Serving via Adaptive Tensor Parallelism
summary_zh: UCSD/GenseeAI 將 tensor parallelism 升格為執行期控制面，每秒級重新選擇 TP 度數、prefill/decode 切割與 SLO 感知排程，解決互動式與後台 traffic 共享 GPU 預算時的多 SLO 階層問題。關鍵機制：每張 GPU 保留全權重 + 各 TP 度的保溫進程（避開 30 秒權重重分佈），以及雙緩衝管線化 KV 遷移（相較 cudaMemcpyAsync 降低 245-376 倍）。Llama-8B/Qwen-14B 在 A100/H100 上 SLO 合規 goodput 達 5.3 倍，4-64 GPU 近線性擴展。
summary_en: UCSD/GenseeAI promote tensor parallelism to a first-class runtime control surface, re-selecting TP degree, prefill/decode split, and SLO-aware schedule every sub-second window to handle the tiered-SLO setting where interactive and background traffic share a fixed GPU budget. Two enabling mechanisms: a full weight copy per GPU plus warm pre-launched processes per TP level (eliminating the ~30s weight redistribution), and double-buffered pipelined KV migration that reduces transfer latency 245-376x versus cudaMemcpyAsync. Delivers up to 5.3x SLO-compliant goodput on Llama-8B/Qwen-14B over A100/H100 clusters and scales near-linearly from 4 to 64 GPUs.
